## Template 1: Server Launch

**Title:** 🎉 [Server Name] is Now Live!

**Body:**
Hey everyone! We're excited to announce that **[Server Name]** is officially open!

**Server IP:** `play.yourserver.com` (port 25565)
**Version:** 1.21.1 (via Velocity: 1.13+)
**Discord:** [discord.gg/yourserver](https://discord.gg/yourserver)

**Features:**
- ✅ Custom survival experience
- ✅ Economy & shops
- ✅ Land claiming (GriefPrevention)
- ✅ Active staff team
- ✅ Regular events

**Join our Discord for support, updates, and community!**

See you in-game!
— The [Server Name] Team

## Template 2: Maintenance Notice

**Title:** ⚠️ Scheduled Maintenance — [Date/Time]

**Body:**
We'll be performing scheduled maintenance on **[Date] at [Time UTC]**.

**Expected downtime:** ~30-60 minutes
**Reason:** [Plugin updates / Version upgrade / Hardware maintenance / Security patches]

**What to expect:**
- Server will be offline during maintenance
- Discord will remain available for updates
- All player data is safe (backups taken before maintenance)

We'll post updates in #announcements on Discord. Thank you for your patience!

— The [Server Name] Team
